title: untyped_columns
description: A non-collection column with no declared type keeps the FHIR JSON representation of its primitive: a boolean stays a boolean, an integer a number, a string a string. Column type inference is optional and treating undeclared types as strings is allowed (https://build.fhir.org/ig/HL7/sql-on-fhir/StructureDefinition-ViewDefinition.html#column-types), but every engine of this runner (in-memory, PostgreSQL, DuckDB) must return the same values for the same view.

tests.title: undeclared primitive columns keep their JSON types
